summary: Review diffs for consequential defects and return prioritized, evidence-backed findings.
intents: review this pull request before merge
look over my diff for bugs
is this change safe to ship
give feedback on the refactor in this branch
check whether the new code has tests
prerequisites: the proposed diff or changed files
repository context; tests or runtime access recommended
verify: Each finding cites a file and line and explains the user impact
Findings are ordered by severity, with nits separated
